survey: A round orange wall clock seen almost straight on, very slightly from the upper left. Its parts: a thick glossy orange torus rim; a cream dial set slightly back inside the rim; 12 navy hour bars with a ring of minute dots between them; and hour, minute and red second hands on a central hub. The clock hangs flat against a green striped wall and casts a soft shadow down and to the right. The rim, the dial edge and the dot ring are near-circles of the same slight squash, so they agree with the near-frontal view. The rim's inner lip shows a little more depth on the lower right, which fits the slight angle. The hour bars point toward the centre and are evenly spaced around the dial. The hub sits at the dial's centre, and the hands lie flat on the face. The wall stripes are vertical and parallel, and the shadow matches a clock mounted flat on the wall.
